page_title: PAU 0-0 RBL | St. Pauli v RB Leipzig 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The attendance for today's match is 29251.
90+2' Scott Banks (St. Pauli) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Jackson Irvine. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Scott Banks (St. Pauli) on for Oladapo Afolayan.
88' Lois Openda picks out Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the left post.
85' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) commits a foul and Robert Hartmann immediately signals a free kick.
84' A snap shot by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Nikola Vasilj produces a good save to thwart him.
83' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) comes onto the pitch for Carlo Boukhalfa.
81' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) plays a lovely through ball to Andre Silva, but he can't beat Nikola Vasilj and loses the ball.
78' A clever short pass gives Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
74' Marco Rose prepares a substitution. Benjamin Sesko is replaced by Andre Silva (RB Leipzig).
74' Substitution. David Raum is replaced by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig).
73' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
72' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
71' The referee is firm and issues Elias Saad (St. Pauli) a deserved yellow card.
69' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) replaces Manolis Saliakas.
69' Substitution. Johannes Eggestein leaves the pitch and is replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli).
69' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) takes the corner with a short pass.
68' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is out of play and St. Pauli manage to earn a corner.

67' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Nikola Vasilj, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
67' 12:6 – the total goal attempt statistics. 4:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
62' Today's match ends for Christoph Baumgartner who will be replaced by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig).
62' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) replacing Amadou Haidara.
62' That will be all from Yussuf Poulsen who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lois Openda (RB Leipzig).

60' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the top right corner, but Nikola Vasilj shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
57' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
56' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
53' Half-chance! Elias Saad (St. Pauli) plays a pass into the box, but Peter Gulacsi reacts well to snuff out the attack.
53' David Raum (RB Leipzig) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
51' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

50' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) accepted an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashed a decent strike towards the top right corner of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, was alert and thwarted the effort. RB Leipzig get a corner.
48' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) sends a long cross over to Yussuf Poulsen, but Nikola Vasilj comes forward to gather the ball.
46' David Raum (RB Leipzig) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' David Raum (RB Leipzig) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the left post.

42' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Peter Gulacsi thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner. However, he couldn't beat Peter Gulacsi, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
41' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) gets inside the box and tries to beat Nikola Vasilj with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
39' A clumsy foul by Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle.
37' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) finds some space inside the box and fires a volley at goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
35' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) watches the cross in from Manolis Saliakas, but plants his header from the edge of the six-yard box well wide of the left post.
31' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

31' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. St. Pauli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
30' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by David Raum (RB Leipzig) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
29' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) was quite harsh and Robert Hartmann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
27' David Raum (RB Leipzig) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
25' Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Hartmann interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
23' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
23' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
22' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
22' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) steps up to send the ball in.

21' A lofted cross from Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out for a corner. St. Pauli can continue in their attacking effort.
21' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) serves up a nice cross, but Peter Gulacsi punches the ball away.
18' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Peter Gulacsi makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
18' What a chance that is! Hauke Wahl swings the ball into the box, and Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar.
18' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) is about to take a corner kick.

17' Great solo effort by Elias Saad (St. Pauli) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the roof of the net. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save. It will be a corner kick for St. Pauli.
15' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from David Raum (RB Leipzig).
12' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
10' RB Leipzig keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

6' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Peter Gulacsi shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
3' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
1' The first half has just begun.
St. Pauli will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Robert Hartmann.
